synth.notes:
Blocks: A1/A2 move y-+4, A3 apart, A4 together (mirrored). Each block stops on its own if its target 4x4 cell leaves [2,58], hits an invisible maze cell, a marker cell, or the other block. Both blocks may cross the midline.
Clicking a marker arms it: blocks become color_1 players and that marker turns active. Armed A1-4 move the active marker +-4 under the same blocking. Click another marker = switch, click a player = disarm, other clicks and A5 do nothing.
Names are type_color_rank, ranked by (y,x); blocks keep the names block_left/right, so other ranks start at 2. Bars: w=floor(3(a+1)/7), and a counts the incoming state only if it matches the last returned state.
Step 124 is explained by an inferred maze cell (22,18) (maze = (14,38),(6,18),(38,14),(22,18)): block_left is blocked alone and block_right still moves. Inferred from the failed move, not seen directly.
Stateless bar fallback: a=0 with no bar, else the top of the width band (w=20 -> a=47, needed for the 20->21 bar at step 12
